ujita: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Ujita. He offers food to Lord Buddha Sikhī first.
ujjagghanta: [U+jaggha+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ujjagghantī] Laughed out loud.
ujjagghiyamāna: [U+jaggha+ya+māna] (ti) CL=7 Should be laughed out loud or laughed aloud.
ujjalacandana: [Ujjala+candana] (na) CL=7 Blazing sandalwood or sandalwood that is blazing.
ujjalagatta: [Ujjala+gatta] (ti) CL=7 With a bright body or shining body.
ujjalita: [U+jala+ta] (ti) CL=7 Blazed up. Set up fire.
ujjalitapadīpa: [Ujjalita+padīpa] (pu) CL=7 An open oil lamp that should set fire.
ujjaliyati: [U+jala+ya+ti] (kri) CL=7 Burns or blazes or kindles.
ujjava: [U+ju+a] (pu) CL=7 Rising thread or yarn and spinning on the shaft or axle.
ujjavana: [U+ju+yu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ujjavanī] A boat goes upstream or a boat goes against the current. See also - Ujjavanika.
ujjavanika: [Ujjavana+ika] (ti) CL=7 Going upstream or against the wind or current.
ujjavati: [U+ju+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 Goes upstream. He goes upstream in a boat.
ujjaya: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 (1) A private Buddha is named Ujjaya. (2) A Thera is named Ujjaya. (3) A Brahmin is named Ujjaya.
ujjayasutta: [Ujjaya+sutta] (na) CL=7 (1) Ujjaya Sutta. In this sutta, Lord Buddha preaches to a Brahmin Ujjaya about which kind of sacrificial offering that is praised by him and which kind of sacrificial offering that is not praised by him. Then he preaches in detail and elaborates version the following: the four dhammas that are the cause of benefits in the present existence and another four dhammas that are the cause of benefits in the next existence.
ujjaṅgala: [U+jaṅgala] (pu) CL=7 (1) Barrel soil or sandy region. (2) The barren region where has salt and natron or detergent powder that appears from the soil.
ujjaṅgalanagaraka: [Ujjaṅgala+nagaraka] (na) CL=7 The town whose soil or earth is rough, wasteland, and uneven soil.
ujjenaka: [Ujjenī+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who was born in Ujjenī country. A Ujjenī townsfolk.
ujjenika: [Ujjenī+ṇika] (thi) CL=7 One who rules over the Ujjenī country. See - Ujjenikarāja.
ujjenikarāja: [Ujjenika+rāja] (pu) CL=7 A king who rules over the Ujjenī country. A king is named Caṇḍapajjota.
ujjeninigama: [Ujjenī+nigama] (pu) CL=7 A village is named Ujjeni.
ujjenivāsī: [Ujjenī+vāsī] (ti) CL=7 One who lives in Ujjain city.
ujjenī: [U+ji+yu+ī] (thī) CL=7 [Uggaṃ ripuṃ jayatiyattha, sā ujjenī, yu, nadādi. Dhāna,ṭī.2vava-1] (1) Ujjenī country. Ujjenī city. (that is the capital city of Avanti country. In the period of living Lord Buddha which country is ruled over by a king Caṇḍapajjota. King Asoka who was young age at the time a prince, ruled over the Ujjenī city and his son ( Ashin Mahinda) was born in that city. Venerable Mahākaccāna and Isidāsī therī were born in that city). (2) A Ujjenī village.  See - Ujjeninigama. A Ujjeni city in India that was established or built by a member of parliament named Accutagāmi.
ujjenīrajja: [Ujjenī+rajja] (na) CL=7 A state of a King of Ujjenī country.
ujjenīrājadhānī: [Ujjenī+rājadhānī] (thī) CL=7 A royal palace of King Ujjenī.
ujjhagghanta: [U+jaggha+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ujjhagghantī] Laugh. Laugh out loudly. See - Ujjagghanta. See also - Ujjagghati.
ujjhatti: [U(=ava)+jhe+ti] (thī) CL=7 Reproaching or blaming. See - Ujjhattibala.
ujjhattibala: [Ujjhatti+bala] (ti) CL=7 One who has power that is reproaching or blaming.
ujjhita: [Ujjha+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Abandoned or gave up. (2) Has caused to happen or arise.
ujjhitasacca: [Ujjhita+sacca] (ti) CL=7 One who gives up (such as the right words (sound). One who gives up the true words (sound).
ujjhitasanthatapaccaya: [Ujjhita+santhata+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is given up a flooring sheet or bedding.
ujjhitussāha: [Ujjhita+ussāha] (ti) CL=7 With an effort that has given up. One who gave up making an effort.
ujjhituṃ: [Ujjha+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To abandon or give up.
ujjhitvā: [Ujjha+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having abandoned or given up.
ujjhiṭṭha: [Ujjha+ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be abandoned or given up. See - Uklāpa.
ujjhāna: [Ava+jhe+yu] (na) CL=7 (A) The mind that is a cause of reproach or blame. (B) Reproaching or blaming. See - Ujjhānasaññī.
ujjhānabahula: [Ujjhana+bahula] (ti) CL=7 One who has the nature of blaming.
ujjhānasaññika: [Ujjhānasaññī+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who was named Ujjhānasaññī. Perceiving fault. With a critical mind.
ujjhānasaññā: [Ujjhāna+saññā] (thī) CL=7 The perception that arises in the critical mind or perceiving fault. The perception of desire to reproach or blame. See - Ujjhānasaññī.
ujjhānasaññī: [Ujjhānasaññā+ī] (ti) CL=7 [Ujjhāna+saññī] (A) With a perception in the critical mind. The perception that is arisen by the power of reproach or blame.  (B) One who recognized (somebody) by a critical mind.
ujjhānasīla: [Ujjhāna+sīla] (ti) CL=7 The habit of reproach or blame or insult.
ujjhāpana: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 (A) Words (sound) of a person that cause another person as an inferior or a lower-level person. See - Ujjhāpanaka. (B) Speaking useless words (sound) to a person and some people see and think of him as an inferior person. Causes to know the manner of an inferior person.
ujjhāpanaka: [Ujjhāpana+ka] (na) CL=7 Words (sound) that are a plan for one as an inferior person that is thought and seen by other people. Reproached or insulted words (sound).
ujjhāpenta: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ujjhāpentī] Makes a plan for one who was thought and seen as an inferior person (by other people).
ujjhāpetabba: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be complained or caused to be looked down upon as an inferior person.
ujjhāpeti: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Reproach or blame or insult. Causes to be thought down as an inferior people. (B) He causes (others) to find fault.
ujjhāpetvā: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused (others) to find fault. Having blamed or reproached or insulted.
ujjhāpetvāna: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+tvāna] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused to speak and know as a manner of an inferior person. See -  ujjhāpana, ujjhātaba.
ujjhāpita: [Ava+jhe+ṇāpe+ta] (ti) CL=7 Caused to be looked down upon as an inferior person. Reproached or blamed or insulted.
ujjhātuṃ: [U(=ava)+jhe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause to be looked down upon as an inferior person. To reproach or insult or blame.
ujjhāyamāna: [Ava+jhe+a+māna] (ti) CL=7 Repraoched or insulted or blamed.
ujjhāyana: [Ava+jhe+yu] (na) CL=7 Reproaching or blaming or insulting.
ujjhāyanattha: [Ujjhāyana+attha] (ti) CL=7 The meaning of reproaching or blaming or insulting.
ujjhāyanta: [Ava+jhe+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ujjhāyantī] Caused to be thought down as an inferior person. Making a plan for one as an inferior person. Reproached or insulted or blamed.
ujjhāyati: [Ava+jhe+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 One who sees (somebody) is recognized as a lower person due to knowing a state of fault.
ujjhāyita: [Ava+jhe+ta]  CL=9 Who is reproached or blamed.
ujjhāyituṃ: [Ava+jhe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To insult or blame or reproach.
ujjhāyitvā: [Ava+jhe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having insulted or blamed or reproached.
ujjitussāha: [In Ujjitussāha aṃ,ṭī,2.193, Ujjitussāha comes from Ujjhitussāha. See - Ujjhitussāha.Tipi,4A,726.
ujjotana: [U+juta+yu] (na) CL=7 Shining or brightness. See - Ujjotanaṭṭha.
ujjotanaṭṭha: [Ujjotana+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of shining or brightness.
ujju: [Ara+ju] (ti) CL=7 Straight-up or righteous or well-trained.
ujjuhāna: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 (1) A mountain named Ujjuhāna. (2) A bird named Ujjuhāna.
ujjālayanta: [U+jala+ṇasa+anta] (ti) CL=7 Cause to be bright or shine.
ujjālayati: [U+jala+ṇaya+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Causes to blaze and burn.
ujjālayitvāna: [U+jala+ṇaya+tvāna] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused to blaze and burn.
ujjāleti: [U+jala+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=7 Causes to blaze and burn.
ujjāletukāma: [Ujjaletuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 Desire to be bright and blaze.
ujjāletuṃ: [U+jala+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause to blaze and burn.
ujotakara: [Ujjota+kara+a] (pu) CL=7 One who makes light or brightness.
uju: [Aja+u] (ti) CL=7 [A changes u. Dhāna,ṭī.708. Ara+ju. Ara changes u. Ṇvādi. 45. Uju+u. Nīti,dhā.47(kaju-saṃ)] (A) Straight-up (not bend). (B) Righteous or honest. (not inferior or not deceit. Lack of deceitful nature such as Māyā sāṭheyya). (C) Well-trained or upright or honest.
ujubhūta: [Uju+bhūta] (ti) CL=7 Reaches a state of honesty. Being upright. Righteous or upright.
ujubhūtadassana: [Ujubhūta+dassana] (na) CL=7 An upright wisdom that reaches a state of righteousness.
ujubhūtaviṭapa: [Ujubhūta+viṭapa] (ti) CL=7 Reaches a state of straightness with a straight tree"s fork. See - Ujuvaṃsa.
ujucittatā: [Uju+citta+tā] (thī) CL=7 (A) As a state of straight mind (that arises by the power of disrespect and not bowing down). (B) With an honest mind.
ujudiṭṭhi: [Uju+diṭṭhi] (ti) CL=7 One who has a righteous doctrine.
ujugata: [Uju+gata] (ti) CL=7 Reaches to a state of being righteous. Practises upright.
ujugatabhūmi: [Ujugata+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 A moment of a stage of upright being.
ujugatachidda: [Ujugata+chidda] (na) CL=7 A hole that is straight.
ujugatakkhandha: [Ujugata+khandha] (ti) CL=7 With a straight tree trunk.
ujugatapañña: [Ujugatā+paññā] (ti) CL=7 With righteous wisdom or knowledge.
ujugatika: [Uju+gati+ka] (ti) CL=7 One whose next existence is a righteous realm.
ujugatta: [Uju+gatta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a straight body.
ujujātika: [Uju+jāti+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who has righteous behavior.
ujuka: [Uju+ka] (ti) CL=7 (A) Straight up or upright. (B) honest or righteous. (C) Honest. (D) Straight. Direct.
ujukameghavuṭṭhi: [Ujuka+meghavuṭṭhi] (thī) CL=7 A raindrop that falls down straight.
ujukaraṇakāla: [Ujukaraṇa+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of doing to be righteous.
ujukasaṇṭhāna: [Ujuka+saṇṭhāna] (na) CL=7 An upright or straight-up appearance.
ujukatā: [Ujuka+tā] (thī) CL=7 As the state of righteousness. Straight up and upright.
ujukaṭṭhapana: [Ujuka+ṭhapana] (na) CL=7 Keeping to be straight up or upright.
ujukkhandha: [Uju+khandha] (ti) CL=7 With a straight tree trunk.
ujumagga: [Uju+magga] (pu) CL=7 The right path or straight road. (A) A natural road. (B) The path that observes rules of conduct. (C) A path that is 11 factors of Kusalakammapatha dhamma. (D) A path that leads to the Brahmin realm (such as Karuṇājhāna). (C) Ariyamagga path (which is the middle path). See also - Ujumaggānusārī.
ujumaggānusārī: [Ujumagga+anusārī] (ti) CL=7 One who always follows Ariya magga (path) which is an upright path.
ujumaggāvaha: [Ujumagga+āvaha] (ti) CL=7 Leads to the righteous path.
ujupaccanīkabhāva: [Uju+paccanīka+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 Be diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujupapattika: [Uju+upapatti+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is righteous. See - Ujugatika.
ujupaṭipakkha: [Uju+paṭipakkha] (pu) CL=7 Diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujupaṭipakkhadassana: [Ujupaṭipakkha+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing a state of diametrically opposed.
ujuppaṭipakkha: [Uju+paṭipakkha] (pu) CL=7 Diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujuppaṭipanna: [Uju+paṭipanna] (ti) CL=7 The practice of living a morally upright life.  (Sangha) who practice on the straight or righteous path.
ujuppaṭipatti: [Uju+paṭipatti] (thī) CL=7 The righteous or upright practice.
ujusabhāva: [Uju+sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 With an upright nature. See - Ujujātika.
ujuvaṃsa: [Uju+vaṃsa] (ti) CL=7 (A) With a straight tree trunk. (B) With a straight tree fork.
ujuvipaccanīka: [Uju+vipaccanīka] (ti) CL=7 Diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujuvipaccanīkabhāva: [Ujuvipaccanīka+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As a state of diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujuvipaccanīkadhamma: [Ujuvipaccanīka+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The Dhamma which is diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujuvipaccanīkakiriya: [Ujuvipaccanīka+kiriya] (ti) CL=7 An action that is diametrically opposed or a state of completely opposite.
ujuvipaccanīkavāda: [Ujuvipaccanīka+vāda] (ti) CL=7 One who has a directly contradictory view or the exact opposite belief or has a diametrically opposed opinion.
ujuvipulavaṭṭakkhandha: [Uju+vipula+vaṭṭa+khandha] (ti) CL=7 A tree trunk which is straight, wide and circular shape.
ujuññā: [Yādicchakanāma] (thī) CL=7 (1) A country is named Ujuññā. (2) A city is named Ujuññā. See also - Uruññā.
ujjhitu: [Ujjha+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To abandon or give up.
ujjhātu: [U(=ava)+jhe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause to be looked down upon as an inferior person. To reproach or insult or blame.
ujjhāyitu: [Ava+jhe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To insult or blame or reproach.
ujjāletu: [U+jala+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause to blaze and burn.
ujuvasa: [Uju+vaṃsa] (ti) CL=7 (A) With a straight tree trunk. (B) With a straight tree fork.
